notes.title: Replica Update Released.
notes.content:
Hello, there.

Replica version 1.8 has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart Replica. 
The major changes include:


Improved Japanese localization with help of Playism
Fixed compatibility with macOS 10.15 Catalina
Fixed minor bugs


And now you can find the new library hero image of Replica in the Steam client. :)

notes.title: New game The Wake is coming soon! A SPECIAL OFFER for all other games of Somi!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37698990/c88000e7062b7e1c591bf857068186272a73bf1f.png


Hi, there. Everyone.

We are super proud to announce that our new game The Wake is COMING SOON!

The Wake is the last of Somi’s “Guilt Trilogy,” consisting of Replica and Legal Dungeon. The Wake discovers past emotions and wounds through the process of reading and deciphering the journal.


Watch The Wake launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=2Y2PTbchzF0;full][/previewyoutube]


The game developer Somi aspires to deliver his thoughts and stories to people through games. 
Replica describes his guilt regarding to widespread signs of fascism in his country. Legal Dungeon shows his sorrow over the dehumanized legal system which is related to his own job.
And finally in The Wake, Somi focuses on his deeper root of guilt. The game is filled with his own memories and past wounds.

 I hope the distress of the single person can be a source of comport to someone else. 


You can WISHLIST the new game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1311540


Sale! Sale! Sale!

To celebrate that, all other games of Somi are on a special offer now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1013750

https://store.steampowered.com/app/496890

https://store.steampowered.com/app/382920

https://store.steampowered.com/app/283660


Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese(PT-BR) Added!!!
notes.content:
New v1.301 Language Update OUT!!!

Added a localization for Brazilian Portuguese(PT-BR), with more localizations on the way!

PT-BR localization is provided by Laura Gassert Thanks to her for the perfect translation.

I've been listening to your feedback, and have corrected a few issues that you've reported.

- Added Brazilian Portuguese.
- Made the location information button in Pictures app bigger.
- Added alphabets in dial pads to be like normal cell phones.
- Fixed minor bugs.

I hope you enjoy the new language, and improvements!
